Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
PAPERS, PLEASE — LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess)

CONTROLS / UI
- Docs spawn at counter left (~0.155, 0.78–0.80); drag onto desk to open/read. Docs can render INVISIBLE yet still grabbable — always probe that spot before concluding a doc is missing.
- Return docs by dragging UP into the window mouth (~0.15, 0.57). Loose papers left on the COUNTER (citations, pink slips, cards) did NOT block NEXT!; what blocked advancing before was clutter on the DESK and/or the extended stamp rail.
- NEXT! = call box on pole (~0.30, 0.22). Two presses typical (first shows tooltip, second summons); if entrant lags, wait ~2 s.
- Gold lever (~0.30, 0.335) toggles the shutter. Clicking near the right-edge drawer tab accidentally closed the shutter once; lever reopened it.
- Stamp drawer tab: right edge (~0.989, 0.44–0.505); position shifts slightly. Click toggles rail out/in. RAIL-EXTENDED state stalled NEXT! before — retract before advancing.
- STAMPING: drag passport so the dashed ENTRY VISA box's TOP BORDER/HEADER sits just under the rail bar, centered under the knob head, then click the knob head. Impressions printed inside the box top or straddling its top border were repeatedly accepted. APPROVED head ~x0.85–0.90, y~0.37–0.42; DENIED head ~x0.63–0.75, y~0.34–0.45 — read per screen.
- Moving docs: grab data rows below the bar; SMALL correction drags. Big drags overshoot; a doc dragged too far right got clipped at the screen edge but was recoverable.
- Verify stamps by retracting the rail or dragging the doc down.
- Bulletin: flip pages by clicking the dog-ear at the page's bottom-right corner (~0.699, 0.851 when page is centered; shifts with page). DRAGGING the dog-ear moves the whole page instead of flipping. Day 2 bulletin had 5 pages; page 5 was the newspaper.
- Store bulletin in bottom-left slot (~0.225, 0.93). Rulebook icon ~(0.216, 0.89–0.92); audio-transcript icon beside it (still UNTESTED).
- Title card: click to reach booth. WALK TO WORK ~(0.5, 0.925). End-of-day: family status screen, SLEEP ~(0.92, 0.89–0.92).
- In this run SLEEP after Day 1 and after Day 2 went straight to the next newspaper — the ledger/payment screen did NOT appear either time. (Uncertain whether it ever appears now.)
- Pause = Escape; no mid-shift save.

RULES BY DAY
- Day 1 (82.11.23): stamp ENTRY VISA; admit Arstotzkan citizens only; deny all foreigners.
- Day 2 (82.11.24): foreigners with valid (current) passports admitted; deny expired/contradictory docs; all docs must be current; inspect mode for discrepancies.
- Day 3: foreigners need valid ENTRY TICKET bearing today's date.
- Day 4: citizens need ID CARD (DOB vs passport, weight vs scale); foreigners need valid ENTRY PERMIT (dates, name, passport number, purpose/duration matching statements).

ENTRANTS & OUTCOMES (this run)
- Day 1: Parsovski (ARSTOTZKA) APPROVED; Ricaurte (IMPOR) denied; Skolowski (REPUBLIA) denied; Holonski (REPUBLIA) denied — all denied without penalty. Day ended by terrorist line 'It was a mistake to open this checkpoint.' End: class 8, 5 credits, family all OK.
- Day 2: Omnik (REPUBLIA, valid) APPROVED — no penalty. Botnari (ARSTOTZKA, EXP 82.11.17 expired) DENIED — no penalty. Pillard (ARSTOTZKA, ISS Tsunkeido, valid) APPROVED. Shortly after, an M.O.A. CITATION appeared on desk: 'Protocol Violated. Passport: Invalid Issuing City — WARNING ISSUED - NO PENALTY' (uncertain which doc triggered it). Ovechkin (ARSTOTZKA, ISS Paradizna, valid) APPROVED. Ahonen (OBRISTAN, ISS Skal, valid) APPROVED — no penalty. Laiovska (ARSTOTZKA, ISS Orvech Vonor, valid) APPROVED. Timoner (ARSTOTZKA, ISS Orvech Vonor) passport was on desk when an explosion in the hall ended Day 2 (verdict unrecorded). End: class 8, 5 credits, family all OK.

CITATIONS / ERRORS
- Invalid Issuing City flagged with WARNING, no penalty, after stamping docs with ISS Glorian/Tsunkeido (Botnari/Pillard). Rulebook city list renders blank, so validity can't be verified; treat unusual city names with caution but don't assume they're invalid.
- Prior sessions: denying valid entrants gave warnings (LAST WARNING stage reached); appearance/photo mismatches gave warnings, not penalties; fake country 'COBRASTAN' → correct to deny.

UNRESOLVED / GUESSES
- Which issuing city (Glorian, Tsunkeido, etc.) is actually invalid — unconfirmed.
- Why the ledger/payment screen never appeared after SLEEP in this run (guess: skipped when no choices/funds, or bug).
- A violet/blue card was seen on the counter near the pink citation slip; never identified — possibly a document tied to an entrant (guess).
- Whether the Day 2 explosion is scripted regardless of actions (likely scripted).
- Whether unchecked loose counter papers must ever be returned/cleared.
- Audio transcript use and how to correlate spoken statements still unexplored.
